result.summary: Found 1 issue: a broken/missing image placeholder in the 'Popular right now' section for Tokumaru Ramen Bar.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows a broken-image placeholder icon (gray crossed-out image symbol) instead of an actual restaurant photo, while the surrounding cards and the pizza card below load images correctly.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source for this restaurant (correct URL/asset) or provide a proper fallback image so the card displays a real photo like the other listings.
